Smart (BOS) briefly engages with Walker (CHA) during the pick but it does not affect his ability to defend.
RLB shows Smart (BOS) makes marginal contact with Bridges's (CHA) arm during the rebound but it does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Zeller (CHA) exits the paint within three seconds.
[Observable in enhanced video] Horford (BOS) slides his pivot foot while he is stationary.
LAR shows Horford (BOS) briefly extends his arms into Walker's (CHA) path while setting the screen.
LAR shows Zeller (CHA) cleanly dislodges the ball from Horford (BOS).
MOB shows Zeller (CHA) makes contact with Morris's (BOS) arms, affecting his ability to maintain control of the ball.
LLB shows Hayward (BOS) makes incidental contact with Parker's (CHA) body in the post.
RLB shows Batum (CHA) makes contact with Hayward's (BOS) arm in the post but it does not affect his SQBR.
Hayward (BOS) engages with Parker's (CHA) back in the post but doesn't affect his ability to defend the pass.
Irving (BOS) establishes legal position in Parker's (CHA) path and briefly engages with Parker (CHA) during the pick but it does not affect his ability to defend.
Walker (CHA) briefly places two hands on Irving's (BOS) body during the pick but contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
LAR shows Walker (CHA) briefly engages with Hayward (BOS) while setting the screen.
Zeller (CHA) establishes legal position in Hayward's (BOS) path and does not deliver contact.
Zeller (CHA) firms up in his screening position on Hayward's (BOS) path and makes contact to his right side but it does not affect his ability to defend through the play.
LAR shows Zeller (CHA) establishes legal position in Smart's (BOS) path and briefly engages with him while setting the pick.
Zeller (CHA) makes contact with Horford's (BOS) arm during the follow-through on his jump shot but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Morris (BOS) and Batum (CHA) briefly engage and disengage with one another during the rebound.
Zeller (CHA) make contact with Irving's (BOS) arm and affects his ability to get to the rebound.

Hayward (BOS) engages with Williams (CHA) but does not affect his FOM.
Hayward (BOS) cleanly dislodges the ball from Williams (BOS) during the inbound.
Walker (CHA) makes marginal contact with Tatum's (BOS) arm but does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
Tatum (BOS) wraps Bridges (CHA) during the rebound affecting his SQBR.
Irving (BOS) commits a take foul on Lamb (CHA).
